judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the definition of done, the spec update, and a failing acceptance test, completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`, the newly added test will fail (`onErrorCalls` will be 0 instead of 1). The candidate also failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria and its own DoD. Finally, instead of adding the test case to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` file like the reference did, it created a separate acceptance test file and left `.lore/dod.md` in the diff.
